introduction: About Behind the Wings® Season 3:Throughout the four new half-hour episodes, aviation professional Shahn Sederberg will lead viewers to exclusive locations around the country. Viewers will get the chance to explore the role of aviation in firefighting in Colorado; visit Cal Fire, one of the largest fire agencies in the world; meet iconic fighter pilots and get an inside look at Century Series jets; hear from aviation icons of the past and present on the legacy of the Learjet and so much more.Episodes include…Season 3, Episode 1: Firefighting Fire From the SkySeason 3, Episode 2: Innovations in Aviation FirefightingSeason 3, Episode 3: The Century Series FightersSeason 3, Episode 4: The Learjet Legacy
